function.name: get_features
function.description: Return requested molecular features for a SMILES string (v14: v13 vocabulary plus neutral fraction, Labute ASA, NOCount, carbocycle counts; metabolites removed).

smiles.description: Input molecule as a SMILES string.

feature_names.description: List of feature names to return for the molecule.

function.name: get_neighbors_ames
function.description: Find nearest neighbors from the AMES training set with labels, similarity scores, and optionally compute selected molecular features for each neighbor.

smiles.description: Input molecule as a SMILES string.

feature_names.description: Optional list of feature categories or RDKit descriptor names to compute for each neighbor.

include_labels.description: Whether to include task labels for neighbors. Default true.
